description: Disk hygiene is half-done. The /tmp workdir IS cleaned (producer.sh:14 trap 'rm -rf $WORK' EXIT) — good. But ~/affiliate/queue grows UNBOUNDED: every producer run mints a new id 'aff$(date +%s)' (producer.sh:13) and drops ~5 PNGs (~400KB) into $QUEUE/$ID, and there is NO consumer to drain it (no run.sh exists), no posted/ archive, and no retention cap. If a daily producer fires but nothing posts, the queue accumulates one ~400KB dir per day forever. Contrast clip/run.sh:92-94 which moves posted clips to ~/clips/posted. HARD 0.26 disk-hygiene is satisfied for /tmp only, not for the queue. Also: id collisions on same-second double-fire reuse the same OUT dir (mkdir -p) with no lock.
